verdict.rationale: Every MCP item in the evidence describes Composio as an MCP server it hosts, such as Composio Connect, session `mcp: true`, and `composio.mcp.create`. None shows Composio consuming or registering external third-party MCP servers as tool sources. Importing outside MCP servers is a plausible capability for a tool-integration platform, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
